featured_reviews.name: Vimall P Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Culinary Journey for the Senses: The Global Veg Treat

In a world where vegetarian dining can sometimes feel repetitive, The Global Veg Treat emerges as a shining beacon of culinary innovation and flavor. This restaurant is not merely a place to eat; it is a destination for those who appreciate the art of plant-based cuisine, and my experience there was nothing short of exceptional.

Let’s start with the most important aspect: the food is an absolute delight. Each dish is a masterclass in flavor, showcasing a thoughtful "global" menu that lives up to its name. From the rich, creamy textures of a perfectly executed Indian paneer makhani to the fresh, zesty notes of a Mediterranean mezze platter, every bite was a journey. The ingredients tasted impeccably fresh, and the complex spice blends demonstrated a kitchen operating at a very high level. It’s the kind of food you crave days after your visit, a true testament to its delicious and memorable quality.

The experience is beautifully complemented by the restaurant's nice ambiance. The interior strikes a perfect balance between cozy and sophisticated, with warm lighting, comfortable seating, and tasteful decor that creates an inviting and relaxed atmosphere. It’s an ideal setting for everything from a quiet, intimate dinner to a celebratory meal with family and friends.

A crucial piece of advice that cannot be overstated: a reservation is absolutely needed. The well-deserved popularity of The Global Veg Treat means that tables are in high demand. Walking in on a whim, especially during weekends, will likely result in a lengthy wait. Planning ahead is a small price to pay for the guaranteed reward of a seamless and wonderful dining experience.

In conclusion, The Global Veg Treat has firmly secured its place as a top-tier vegetarian restaurant. With its sublime food, charming atmosphere, and evident popularity, it delivers on every promise. Do yourself a favor and book a table—your taste buds will thank you.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Must-try Mocktails:
Videshi Kala Khatta – a tangy twist with an international flair
Fruitee Passion – refreshing and packed with tropical notes

Appetisers:
Cheesy Baked Pav Bhaji Fondue – a creative and indulgent spin on a classic
Spicy Steamed Wontons – perfectly spiced, soft and flavorful

Mains:
Qasr-e-Pukhtan – a royal paneer gravy rich in desi ghee, paired beautifully with flaky warqi parathas

The restaurant also offers various seating sections and is very accessibility-friendly, with a stair chair lift available for elderly guests or anyone with mobility challenges, since it’s located on the first floor .

featured_reviews.review_text:
Shagun Veg Restaurant in Dahisar is a place I have been visiting for over 20 years now, and I still absolutely love the food here. I usually prefer ordering home delivery, but I have also dined in a few times. They have a simple indoor seating area with air conditioning, and the ambience feels like a quick-service restaurant.

My favourites here are Idli, Masala Dosa, Pav Bhaji, and Veg Thali. I also enjoy their Veg Kolhapuri, Veg Pulao, and Idli Fry. My all-time favourite dish here would definitely be the Veg Biryani. The food is always well-prepared, and the taste has remained consistent through the years.

What I really appreciate is how they have maintained their quality consistently throughout these years. I absolutely recommend ordering from here if you live in or around Dahisar. They also provide home delivery services.

Ratings:
Quality – 3.8/5
Quantity – 4/5
Service – 4/5
Price – ₹500 for 2 people

For more mouthwatering food content, don’t forget to follow @chefvaidehipathare on Instagram!

featured_reviews.name: vishal sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Sizzling Spices in Dahisar with my friends this weekend, and it turned out to be a delightful experience for Asian food lovers. The place is small but cozy, with quick and humble service that makes you feel welcome.

We began with the Chicken Eight Treasure Soup, which was packed with a variety of vegetables along with chicken – light, healthy, and a good start. Next came the Korean-style Crispy Chicken, essentially chicken katsu paired with honey chilli sauce. While the sauce was average, the katsu itself was perfectly crispy and enjoyable.

The highlight of the evening was undoubtedly the Chicken Thai Green Curry Pot Rice. Aromatic, rich in flavor, and served in a portion easily sufficient for three, it stood out as the star dish.

Overall, Sizzling Spices is a nice spot if you’re in the mood for hearty and flavorful Asian cuisine. Definitely worth a visit.

featured_reviews.name: Danny Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently placed an order from Sizzling Spices, and the highlight of my meal was undeniably the Chicken Thai Pot Rice. This dish is a true testament to the restaurant's dedication to delivering authentic Thai flavors in a sizzling and satisfying way.
The presentation of the Chicken Thai Pot Rice was visually appealing, served in a sizzling hot pot. The aroma alone was enough to make my mouth water. The dish featured tender pieces of chicken, perfectly cooked and seasoned to perfection, accompanied by a generous serving of rice.
The Thai spices were expertly balanced, offering a delightful combination of sweet, sour, and spicy notes. Fresh herbs and vegetables added a refreshing crunch to each bite, while the fragrant lemongrass and coconut milk infused the dish with an authentic Thai essence.The portion size was generous, making it ideal for sharing or savoring as a satisfying meal. The sizzling pot kept the dish warm throughout the meal, ensuring that every bite was as enjoyable as the first.

Few dishes evoke the feeling of warmth, luxury, and celebration quite like a classic European roast. When the weekend rolls around, or when you simply want to reward yourself after a long week, searching for premium restaurants near me should lead you straight to a dish that feels like a celebration on a plate: our signature Rosemary Roast Chicken.

Crafted by our expert culinary team at Royale Masterchef Fine Dine & Bar, this dish is an absolute triumph of traditional cooking techniques. We take a prime cut of plump chicken, rub it generously with aromatic fresh rosemary, garlic, sea salt, and premium butter, and roast it until the skin achieves a flawless, crackling golden hue. Inside, the meat remains incredibly juicy, completely infused with the earthy, pine-like aroma of fresh herbs. Served alongside roasted root vegetables and a rich, savory pan-dripping gravy, it is a rustic yet sophisticated feast.

Whether you choose to pair your meal with a premium wine from our curated cellar, a signature cocktail from our lively bar counter, or enjoy it amidst the ambient lighting of our relaxed family lounge, Royale Masterchef ensures an incomparable dining experience in Dahisar West, Mumbai.

featured_reviews.review_text:
“Four Years, Dozens of Visits — This Review Is Long Overdue”

This review comes with an apology — to the restaurant.
I should have written this after my first visit, four years ago. What followed instead were repeated visits, quiet trust, and the kind of consistency that makes you forget to review… because you stop evaluating and start relying.

Ambience ⭐⭐⭐⭐½ /5
Royale Masterchef strikes a rare balance — elegant without being intimidating. The warm wood-paneled interiors, comfortable seating, and calm lighting make it equally suitable for couples, families, and even large groups. Over the years, I’ve been here with parents, with friends, and just as a couple — and the space adapts effortlessly each time.

Service ⭐⭐⭐⭐½ /5
There’s free valet parking (a blessing in Dahisar), and over time the staff has come to recognise me — which naturally elevates my experience. That said, even without familiarity, the service has always been polite, professional, and patient. On weekends it gets busy, and food does take time — but that time shows up on the plate. Good food doesn’t need shortcuts.

Food ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ /5
This is why I keep coming back.
Consistency is their superpower.

My regular orders over the years say enough: Chicken Cheese Kebab, Chicken Reshmi Kebab, Southern Fried Chicken, Honey Mustard Chicken, Chicken Tikka Masala, Mutton Biryani, Hakka Noodles, Chilli Garlic Noodles, and the dangerously good Mud Cake with Vanilla Ice Cream. I’ve explored nearly 90% of the menu, and it’s expansive. One honest miss? Chicken Lollipop — skip it.

Everything else? Gourmet-level execution that never fluctuates.

Drinks ⭐⭐⭐⭐ /5
From classic pours to simple pairings, the drinks complement the food well. This was once a regular stop for a quiet drink with dinner — responsibly adjusted now that I drive.

Value ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ /5
In four years, pricing has increased only once — and that too felt like inflation control, not opportunism. The value has remained intact.

Final Thoughts
This is not a flashy place. It doesn’t chase trends.
It just delivers — every single time.

Would I return? ✔
I already do. Again and again.

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Aundhakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Banjara Restaurant in Borivali is one of the most popular family dining spots in the area — known for its delicious food, pleasant ambience, and courteous service. It perfectly balances taste, presentation, and hospitality, making it an excellent choice for both casual meals and family gatherings.

The food quality is top-notch. The North Indian and Mughlai dishes are especially outstanding — rich in flavor, perfectly spiced, and cooked with fresh ingredients. Their Butter Chicken, Paneer Tikka Masala, and Mutton Rogan Josh are crowd favorites. The Banjara Special Biryani deserves a special mention — aromatic, well-cooked rice with tender pieces and balanced masala.

They also serve good Chinese and Continental options. The Manchow Soup, Hakka Noodles, and Crispy Veg are quite popular among regulars.

The ambience is elegant and comfortable — dim lighting, spacious seating, and a relaxed family-friendly vibe. It’s clean, well-maintained, and gives a premium dining feel without being overly expensive.

Service is excellent. The staff is professional, well-trained, and attentive. Food arrives on time even during weekends when the restaurant is crowded.

Value for money: Slightly on the higher side compared to regular eateries, but completely worth it for the quality, taste, and overall experience.

What I liked:
✅ Excellent quality food with authentic flavors
✅ Elegant and comfortable ambience
✅ Courteous and efficient staff
✅ Wide variety of dishes for both veg and non-veg lovers

What can improve:

Parking space is limited during weekends

Slight waiting time during peak hours (reservation recommended)

Overall:
Banjara Restaurant in Borivali is a perfect blend of taste, comfort, and quality. Whether you’re dining with family, celebrating a special occasion, or simply craving rich Indian food, this place never disappoints. Highly recommended for food lovers who value both flavor and atmosphere.
